arguments.notes:
DATABASE: PostgreSQL-style (not SQLite; sqlite_master unavailable). Table names are case-sensitive and must be double-quoted, e.g. "APINVH". information_schema.columns works for discovery.

TABLES (row counts at time of exploration):
- APINVH (804) AP invoice header: INV_ID int PK, VEND_CD char, INV_NO text (vendor invoice no), INV_DT int (YYYYMMDD), INV_AMT numeric, STAT_CD char, JRNL_NO int.
- APPAYM (519) AP payments: PAY_ID int PK, INV_ID int, PAY_DT int (YYYYMMDD), PAY_AMT numeric.
- APVEND (24) vendor master: VEND_CD char(8 space-padded) PK, VEND_NM text, ACTV_FLG char.
- GLCOA (10) chart of accounts: ACCT_CD char(8 space-padded) PK, ACCT_NM text, ACCT_TYP text, ACTV_FLG char.
- GLJRNH (1475) journal headers: JRNL_NO int PK, PRD_ID int, POST_DT int (YYYYMMDD), POST_FLG char, REF_JRNL_NO int, SRC_CD char, SRC_REF text (keyed-by user name), MEMO text (free text).
- GLJRNL (3493) journal lines: (JRNL_NO, LN_SEQ) composite key, ACCT_CD char, DR_AMT numeric, CR_AMT numeric.
- GLPERD (12) periods: PRD_ID int PK, STRT_DT, END_DT, CLOSE_DT int (YYYYMMDD), STAT_CD char. Covers 2024 (ids 1..12 presumed monthly; PRD_ID 1 to 12).
- SYSDICT (34) data dictionary: TBL_NM, COL_NM, DESCR. Covers all business tables' columns (not SYSDICT itself).

RELATIONSHIPS (none declared as constraints; all inferred and verified by orphan checks, all returned 0 orphans except noted):
- APINVH.VEND_CD -> APVEND.VEND_CD (0 orphans)
- APINVH.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO (every invoice has a journal, 0 orphans)
- APPAYM.INV_ID -> APINVH.INV_ID (0 orphans)
- GLJRNL.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO (0 orphans)
- GLJRNL.ACCT_CD -> GLCOA.ACCT_CD: 1 orphan (JRNL_NO 1979, LN_SEQ 1, ACCT_CD '5950' not in chart of accounts)
- GLJRNH.PRD_ID -> GLPERD.PRD_ID (0 orphans)
- GLJRNH.REF_JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO: self-reference, set on 1 row (JRNL_NO 2471 reverses 2320; memo "Reversal of accrual 2320").

CONVENTIONS / CODES (verified against data):
- Dates are integers in YYYYMMDD form (8 digits, consistent). APINVH 20240101-20241220; APPAYM 20240108-20241228; GLJRNH 20240101-20241228. GLPERD STRT_DT/END_DT are YYYYMMDD; PRD_ID is 1..12 (note: GLPERD min/max length output was ambiguous, but PRD_ID values 1-12 are confirmed).
- Amounts are numeric, unsigned for DR/CR lines (no negatives in GLJRNL; debit and credit held in separate columns). Invoice amounts are signed in APINVH.
- APINVH.STAT_CD: O open (285), P paid (519). Dictionary also lists V void, but NO 'V' rows exist in the data.
- APINVH.STAT_CD P invoices all have payments; no O invoices have payments; payments never exceed invoice amount in absolute terms.
- GLJRNH.POST_FLG: only 'P' posted (1475 rows). Dictionary says U unposted also exists, but none present.
- GLJRNH.SRC_CD: AP (1323), GL (152).
- GLJRNH.SRC_REF: dictionary says "name of user who keyed the entry" - not verified in detail.
- GLPERD.STAT_CD: C closed (10), O open (2). 1172 journal headers sit in closed periods (normal, but noteworthy if the audit period is open periods).
- GLCOA.ACCT_TYP: ASSET (2), EXPENSE (6), LIABILITY (2). Dictionary lists only these three; no EQUITY/REVENUE types exist in the 10-account chart (note: revenue/equity accounts appear absent entirely).
- ACTV_FLG on APVEND and GLCOA: Y (all 24 vendors Y; GLCOA values not checked in detail). Dictionary: Y active, N retired.
- Char code columns are space-padded (VEND_CD, ACCT_CD are char(8)); joins on them work only when padding is consistent (verified joins succeed).

SUSPICIOUS / DOCUMENTATION DISCREPANCIES:
1. Journal 1075 is unbalanced: DR 6654.87 vs CR 6663.87 (difference 9.00). Across all journals, total DR 16,819,129.85 vs total CR 16,819,138.85 (difference 9.00). Books do not balance in total.
2. Journal 1979 line 1 posts to ACCT_CD '5950' which is not in GLCOA (orphan account).
3. Negative open invoice: INV_ID 802, vendor V0012, INV_AMT -1114.27, status O. Possibly a credit memo recorded as an invoice; the schema has no distinct credit-memo type.
4. Dictionary says STAT_CD includes V (void) and POST_FLG includes U (unposted); neither value occurs. Dictionary is incomplete or stale relative to data.
5. Dictionary says ACCT_TYP is ASSET/LIABILITY/EXPENSE only; chart has no equity or revenue accounts, which is unusual for a general ledger and may indicate an incomplete chart.
6. Dictionary is otherwise accurate for the columns it covers (it does not document GLPERD.CLOSE_DT, GLJRNH.PRD_ID period semantics, or that GLPERD.CLOSE_DT exists in the table at all; it lists GLPERD.STRT_DT, END_DT, PRD_ID, STAT_CD only). APINVH/APPAYM/GLJRNL columns are all covered.
7. Undocumented columns: GLPERD.CLOSE_DT, and the dictionary doesn't document APVEND/GLCOA ACTV_FLG value-coverage fully.
8. Data sanity: GL journals total ~16.8M debit with 1475 journals; AP invoices 804 rows max ~25k each.

AUDIT FOCUS SUGGESTIONS: reconcile the 9.00 out-of-balance (journal 1075 and any others); investigate account 5950 in journal 1979; confirm sign treatment of negative invoice 802 (credit memo); confirm closed-period postings (1172 journals in closed periods) were authorised; check journal 2471 reversal of 2320 for correct amounts.
